Introduction

This article demonstrates a well-structured page with complete Schema.org markup, proper semantic HTML, and rich content. According to recent research, pages with structured data are 3x more likely to be featured in AI-generated answers.

"Structured data is the foundation of machine-readable web content." — Web Standards Expert

Frequently Asked Questions

What is structured data?

Structured data is a standardized format for providing information about a page.

Why use JSON-LD?

JSON-LD is Google's recommended format for structured data markup.

How does it help AI agents?

AI agents can parse structured data to understand page content without rendering.

The source of this data comes from extensive testing across 500 websites. Reference: Web Quality Report 2024.
